summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the parallel listing and admission of 101,826,580 common voting shares on the Main Market of Euronext Athens, along with a total voting rights disclosure under Greek law. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendations are provided. The filing is a routine regulatory notification of corporate housekeeping, not a special situation transaction. It lacks any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation trigger. The equivalent US filing would be a notice of listing or share count update.
